svg.aria-label: yolowpdf: Recursive X-Y cut reading order; Is this word text or math?; Rebuild fractions from geometry; Map glyphs into page space; Headers that carry page numbers; Re-run a page only on evidence; A timeout from extreme-value theory; Wait for one more line?
svg.title: yolowpdf — GEOMETRY × STATISTICS
svg.desc: Recursive X-Y cut reading order. Nagy & Seth 1984 · Ha et al. 1995 · Breuel 2002. cut at an empty projection band, recurse ≤ 5. Full-width title and abstract rows are peeled first; guards stop equation numbers and margin line numbers from faking a column. Is this word text or math?. Rabiner (1989) · Garain & Chaudhuri (2005). s* = argmax Σ E(w_t, s_t) + T(s_t−1 → s_t). Hand-set log-scores rather than trained ones; staying in Math past a sentence end costs 3.2, and braces may absorb 3 prose words. Rebuild fractions from geometry. Anderson 1968 · DRACULAE 2002 · TeXbook G. axis = y_bar − 0.25·size, overlap ≥ 0.50. The rebuilt fraction is folded back into one glyph, so the layout stages downstream never see the difference. Map glyphs into page space. ISO 32000 · PDF text space. T_rm = S(T_fs, T_h, T_rise) · T_m · CTM. Direction snaps to quarter-turns with a 10% skew tolerance; Type3 em size is estimated as 2× median width when off by > 4×. Headers that carry page numbers. self-developed · layout/furniture.rs. folio − page index = const on ≥ 3 pages. Strip the folio, then match the offset — or the same text at the same height (±1 pt) — inside the top 12% / bottom 20% zones. Re-run a page only on evidence. Wilson (JASA 1927) · Fisher (1925) δ. Wilson_lower(k/n) > δ = 0.05 ⇒ re-route. k counts garbled and unmapped glyphs; a page is re-parsed by another route only when even the pessimistic bound says it is broken. A timeout from extreme-value theory. Pickands (1975) · Balkema & de Haan (1974). q_1−ε = u + m·ln(δ/ε), ε = δ/n. ln t is regressed on ln bytes; beyond the largest file seen the slope is 1, and each thread updates its own copy without locks. Wait for one more line?. Kleinrock (1975) Queueing Systems §3.2. wait ⇔ n/λ < (a/(n+1)) / (1 − ρ). Queueing theory sets the latency/utilisation trade-off instead of a fixed batch size; GPU OCR is capped at 4 workers under cgroup admission.
